evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read as a bookcase only through the books inside; the silhouette is a plain tall rectangle with a cornice lip and the top view is a featureless brown slab.
evidence.V2: Big (case), medium (cornice, three shelves, book groups), small (gold spine bands, cream/dark book value variation) hierarchy is clear.
evidence.V3: Cornice overhang and varied book heights/leans help, but the case is a straight box and the books are uniform rectangular blocks with no rounded spines, so it reads partly primitive.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers catch light on cornice, side posts, shelf lips and book edges in the top, plinth and books close-ups.
evidence.V5: Books, plinth and top close-ups show clean shading with no pinches, seams or z-fighting; books sit on the shelves.
evidence.V6: Wood frame in 2-3 values, one book hue in three values plus cream books and gold bands; disciplined across colourways.
evidence.V8: Vertex-coloured wood + one fabric/book hue, kit cream and gold accents, chamfered edges match the furniture kit.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; A1-A18 pass.

top_fixes: Break the box silhouette: shaped/arched cornice or crest, stepped plinth or bracket feet, side-panel cutouts
Round the book spines and add one leaning or lying stack so the books read as books, not blocks
Add a small prop or two (jar, candle) on a shelf for silhouette breakup
